camel_example: aliyun ndr ListProtoLogSupportIndex --region cn-hangzhou --Site global --version 2024-01-24 --method POST --force
description_en: Queries the public index fields, filter operators, and group-by statistics capabilities supported by the current log storage. Call this operation before constructing a LogFilter or calling DescribeProtoLogFieldStatistics. When querying across multiple sites, keep the Site parameter consistent
description_zh: 查询当前日志存储支持的公开索引字段、过滤运算符及分组统计能力。构造 LogFilter 或调用 DescribeProtoLogFieldStatistics 前，可先查询本接口；多站点查询时保持 Site 一致
name: ListProtoLogSupportIndex

parameters.help_en: The log query site. You can obtain the value from the Sites parameter returned by DescribeDeliveryDestination. In multi-site scenarios, the specified site is used preferentially if it is valid. If no site is specified or the specified site is unavailable, the system automatically selects an available site. If only one site is available, that site is used. If no site is available, LogDeliveryNotOpen is returned
parameters.help_zh: 日志查询站点，可从 DescribeDeliveryDestination 返回的 Sites 中获取。多站点场景下优先使用有效的指定站点；未指定或指定站点不可用时，系统自动选择可用站点。仅有一个可用站点时使用该站点；无可用站点时返回 LogDeliveryNotOpen
parameters.name: site

List.description_en: The list of log indexing fields that support querying
List.description_zh: 支持查询的日志索引字段列表

DescriptionCn.description_en: The Chinese description of the index field

DescriptionEn.description_en: The English description of the index field

EnumValues.description_en: The list of valid values for the field. This parameter may be empty if no enumeration is configured
EnumValues.description_zh: 字段可选值列表；未配置枚举时可能为空

items.description_en: A valid value of the field. The value corresponds to the current index field
items.description_zh: 该字段的一个可选值。应与当前索引字段对应

LogKey.description_en: The index field name, which is used as the logField in LogFilter.logFilterItems. Fields that support grouping can also be used as LogField
LogKey.description_zh: 索引字段名，用于 LogFilter.logFilterItems 中的 logField；支持分组的字段也可作为 LogField

NdrLogType.description_en: The NDR log type to which the index field belongs. This parameter may be empty for public or composite fields
NdrLogType.description_zh: 该索引字段所属的 NDR 日志类型；公共或组合字段可能为空

SupportGroupBy.description_en:
Indicates whether the field supports group-by statistics. Valid values:
true: Supported.
false: Not supported
SupportGroupBy.description_zh: 是否支持按该字段分组统计。true 表示支持，false 表示不支持

SupportOperators.description_en: The list of filter operators supported by the field. Use the returned operators when constructing filter conditions
SupportOperators.description_zh: 该字段支持的过滤运算符列表。构造条件时使用返回的运算符

items.description_en: The filter operator. Valid values: = (equal to), != (not equal to), > (greater than), >= (greater than or equal to), < (less than), <= (less than or equal to), ~ (match), !~ (not match), startswith (prefix match), exists (field exists), notexists (field does not exist). The available operators for each field are determined by the list returned in this parameter
items.description_zh: 过滤运算符：= 表示等于，!= 表示不等于，> 表示大于，>= 表示大于等于，< 表示小于，<= 表示小于等于，~ 表示匹配，!~ 表示不匹配，startswith 表示前缀匹配，exists 表示字段存在，notexists 表示字段不存在。每个字段的可用运算符以当前项返回的列表为准

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of index fields returned

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails. This parameter is empty when the request succeeds. The example shows a scenario where log delivery is not enabled
ErrorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时的错误码；请求成功时为空。示例展示日志投递未开通场景

Message.description_en: The result message of the request. This parameter describes the error cause when the request fails. The example shows a scenario where log delivery is not enabled
Message.description_zh: 请求结果信息；失败时用于说明错误原因。示例展示日志投递未开通场景

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位本次请求

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: The request is successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败
